capabilities.scope: On one operator-reported V1.2 sample, a battery-powered normal POWER-on boot from NOR reached the ESP_MOSAICO kernel and a single-user shell with an FFS memory-disk root. This does not establish NAND boot, full PSRAM read/write or general peripheral support.
Vendor-firmware WebUI and a bounded live-log connection observed. No EmberBSD radio or sustained-transfer result.
Type-C USB-OTG ROM connection and complete 16 MiB NOR readback verified with esptool 5.6.0. This does not establish an EmberBSD USB console or a successful firmware restore.

On one V1.2 sample, the vendor factory firmware showed a visible UI and touch responded. In EmberBSD, CO5300 framebuffer and CST9220 touch drivers attached; earlier touch checks produced changing coordinates and contact events. A RAM trial with the published ESP32-S31 SPI idle-high initialization still left the display black; CO5300 status reads returned all-0xff values without bus errors. Orientation, calibration and audio function were not verified.

On one V1.2 sample, the left-slot camera EEPROM descriptor had valid CRCs and hardware-version field 0x0102. The factory firmware separately reported SC101IOT PID 0xda4a and rendered a changing 1280 × 720 UYVY preview. The optional EmberBSD SC101IOT ID probe at 0x68 failed GPIO-control acquisition with ENXIO before reading an ID; no DVP capture is implemented. An OV3640 node also attached at 0x3c and failed XCLK lookup after claiming GPIO controls; this does not identify the sensor. The factory result does not establish sensor identity for other modules.
